verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an on-premises or self-hosted deployment of Secureframe's core product. Ingesting data from on-prem systems via the API, and the separate MCP server repository, are adjacent features and do not amount to self-hosting the core platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
